relations.subject: Carl Rudolph Samuel Peiper
relations.evidence: Married 1824 Emilie Raupbach (1804–1828) and 1831 Auguste Richter (1804–1889), two daughters with first and six sons and one daughter with second, i. al. the classical philologist Rudolf Peiper (1834–98).
